gravity.name: Gravity (free weight)
gravity.formula: F = m·(g − a_load) at the grip, straight down when still
gravity.profile: Constant magnitude, always vertical. The demand on a joint is F × the horizontal distance from the joint to the line of the load (moment arm), so it changes through the range as that distance changes.

elastic.name: Elastic (band)
elastic.formula: F = k·(L − L₀) along the band, k = F_rated / (L_rated − L₀); zero when slack
elastic.profile: Ascending: tension rises as the band lengthens, so it is lowest at the start of a pull or press and highest at the end.

elastic_knees.name: Elastic between the knees
elastic_knees.formula: F = k·(d − L₀) pulling the knees together (d = knee-to-knee distance)
elastic_knees.profile: Grows as the knees move apart: the hip abductors must resist an adduction moment that scales with knee width.

bar_bands.name: Barbell + bands (accommodating)
bar_bands.formula: F = m·g + 2·k·(h − h₀), the band term growing with bar height h
bar_bands.profile: Weight plus band tension: heavier near lockout, lighter in the bottom, matching the usual strength curve of squat, bench and deadlift.

cable.name: Cable over a pulley
cable.formula: F = stack·g / ratio, directed from the handle to the pulley (pulley friction ignored)
cable.profile: Constant magnitude like a free weight, but the direction follows the cable, so the load can be horizontal or upward and the moment arm is measured to the cable line.

landmine.name: Landmine (lever on a floor pivot)
landmine.profile: With a vertical hand force, the angle cancels: the hand carries a fixed fraction of the bar and plates, smaller than their full weight. The bar's arc guides the path.

sled.name: Sled (sliding friction)
sled.formula: F = μ·(m_sled + m_plates)·g, horizontal through the harness
sled.profile: Constant while sliding. μ depends on the surface and sled runners: set it for your surface (the default is an example, not a measured value).

none.name: Body-weight apparatus or layout
none.formula: No external load is added; the body is the load
none.profile: Used for set-up geometry (heights, spacing, path) and for drills.

drills.Block 3 drill (wk 9-12): Back squat heavy (cluster sets) or contrast with jumps
drills.Set-up & execution (Block 1 drill): Bar on upper back, hands just outside shoulders, feet shoulder-width; brace, sit down between the hips to at least parallel, drive up keeping chest and hips rising together.
drills.Coaching cues: Big breath and brace before each rep; knees out over toes; whole foot on floor
drills.Common errors / safety: Good-morning out of the hole; losing brace; depth lost as load rises

drills.Set-up & execution (Block 1 drill): Hold the bar at hip height, soft knees, push hips back sliding the bar down the thighs to mid-shin while keeping the spine long; drive hips forward to stand.
drills.Coaching cues: Bar touches legs the whole time; lats tight ('bend the bar')
drills.Common errors / safety: Rounding the back; bar drifting forward

drills.Set-up & execution (Block 1 drill): Bar on upper back, step back into a lunge to a light knee touch, drive up through the front foot.
drills.Coaching cues: Stay tall; front shin near vertical

drills.Block 3 drill (wk 9-12): Bench press + medicine-ball chest pass contrast
drills.Set-up & execution (Block 1 drill): Lie with eyes under the bar, shoulder blades pinched, feet planted; lower the bar to the lower chest with forearms vertical, press back up.
drills.Coaching cues: Elbows about 45°; bar path slightly diagonal; leg drive
drills.Common errors / safety: Bouncing off the chest; flaring elbows; hips lifting

drills.Set-up & execution (Block 1 drill): Bar in front rack, grip just outside shoulders; brace and press straight up moving the head back then through, finish with the bar over mid-foot.
drills.Coaching cues: Squeeze glutes; bar finishes over the ears
drills.Common errors / safety: Leaning back; pressing in front of the face

drills.Block 3 drill (wk 9-12): Seal row / chest-supported barbell row heavy
drills.Set-up & execution (Block 1 drill): Hinge to 30-45°, bar hanging under shoulders; row to lower ribs, lower under control.
drills.Coaching cues: Fixed torso angle; pull with elbows
drills.Common errors / safety: Standing up as you row; jerking

drills.Block 1 drill (wk 1-4): Barbell landmine-style rotation is preferred — use barbell rollout as trunk drill
drills.Block 2 drill (wk 5-8): Barbell anti-rotation (Pallof-style) not suitable — see Landmine
drills.Set-up & execution (Block 1 drill): Kneel holding a loaded barbell with plates as wheels; roll forward until the trunk nearly parallels the floor, return without sagging.

drills.Block 3 drill (wk 9-12): Standing barbell rollout (partial) or offset-loaded barbell carry
drills.Set-up & execution (Block 1 drill): Kneel holding a barbell with plates as wheels; roll forward until the trunk is nearly parallel to the floor, then pull back with the abs and lats without letting the low back sag.
drills.Coaching cues: Ribs down, glutes squeezed, move as one plank
drills.Common errors / safety: Low back sagging; hips leading the return

drills.Set-up & execution (Block 1 drill): As the RDL but lower over 3 s to the point of hamstring tension, keep knees soft.

drills.Block 2 drill (wk 5-8): Seated barbell calf raise (bar across knees)
drills.Block 3 drill (wk 9-12): Barbell single-leg calf raise on step
drills.Set-up & execution (Block 1 drill): Bar on back, balls of feet on a plate; lower the heels below the plate, rise fully, pause.
drills.Coaching cues: Push through big toe; slow lowering

drills.Block 1 drill (wk 1-4): Barbell Spanish-style wall squat isometric (5 x 45 s)
drills.Set-up & execution (Block 1 drill): Heavy slow resistance: 3-s down, 3-s up, 4 sets at 15RM progressing to 6RM over 12 weeks (Kongsgaard 2009).
Hold the bar in the front rack and walk 20-30 m tall and braced.

drills.Block 1 drill (wk 1-4): Landmine goblet squat (hold sleeve end at chest)
drills.Block 2 drill (wk 5-8): Landmine squat with 3-s eccentric and 1-s bottom pause
drills.Set-up & execution (Block 1 drill): Barbell end in a landmine or corner; cup the sleeve at sternum with both hands, feet shoulder-width, bar angle lets you sit back. Squat until thighs at least parallel, drive up through mid-foot.
drills.Coaching cues: Chest tall into the bar; knees track over 2nd-3rd toe; exhale through the top
drills.Common errors / safety: Leaning onto the bar; heels lifting; bar too short for tall athletes (use plates under pivot)

drills.Block 1 drill (wk 1-4): Landmine Romanian deadlift (two hands, straddle bar)
drills.Block 2 drill (wk 5-8): Single-leg landmine RDL (bar in opposite hand)
drills.Set-up & execution (Block 1 drill): Straddle the bar facing the pivot, sleeve between feet, hands on the sleeve. Soft knees, push hips back until hamstrings tension (bar about mid-shin), stand by driving hips forward.
drills.Coaching cues: Long spine from head to tailbone; bar stays close; squeeze glutes at the top without leaning back
drills.Common errors / safety: Rounding the low back; squatting instead of hinging; hyperextending at lockout

drills.Set-up & execution (Block 1 drill): Hold the sleeve at chest, step one foot back into a lunge until the back knee nearly touches the floor; front shin near vertical; drive through the front heel to return.
drills.Coaching cues: Front knee over toes, pelvis level; slow down, drive up
drills.Common errors / safety: Short stride causing knee pain; trunk twisting toward the bar

drills.Block 3 drill (wk 9-12): Landmine push-press / rotational press from hip
drills.Set-up & execution (Block 1 drill): Half-kneel on the side opposite the pressing hand, sleeve at shoulder, elbow about 45°. Press up and forward along the arc to full reach, letting the shoulder blade glide forward at the end.
drills.Coaching cues: Ribs down, glute of the down knee squeezed; reach through at the top
drills.Common errors / safety: Arching the low back; shrugging; flaring elbow to 90°

drills.Set-up & execution (Block 1 drill): Kneel tall, hold the sleeve with both hands at the chest; press the bar up the arc to arms' length, ribs down. The arc gives a shoulder-friendly overhead pattern for those who can't press straight up yet.
drills.Coaching cues: Squeeze glutes; finish with biceps by ears only if range allows
drills.Common errors / safety: Leaning back to reach; pressing with a painful arc

drills.Block 3 drill (wk 9-12): Landmine row with 2-s hold at top
drills.Set-up & execution (Block 1 drill): Straddle the bar near the sleeve, V-handle under the bar, hinge to about 45°. Row the handle to the lower ribs, pause, lower under control.
